nodes.title: Models & downloads
widgets_values:
## MODELS TO DOWNLOAD

All files are from **Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4**.

### Conditional diffusion model
[⬇ ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors · 9.28 GB](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ideogram4_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

Install to: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/

### Unconditional diffusion model
[⬇ ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors · 9.28 GB](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4/resolve/main/diffusion_models/ideogram4_unconditional_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

Install to: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/

### Text encoder
[⬇ qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors · 10.59 GB](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_8b_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

Install to: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/

### VAE
[⬇ flux2-vae.safetensors · 0.34 GB](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Ideogram-4/resolve/main/vae/flux2-vae.safetensors)

Install to: ComfyUI/models/vae/

After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists with **R**.

**Workflow graph:** core nodes plus ONE custom node, [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes), for the prompt builder. If you want a core-nodes-only graph, use Ideogram4_Mac.json instead.

**Apple Silicon runtime requirement:** [ComfyUI-AppleSilicon-FP8](https://github.com/pawel-mazurkiewicz/ComfyUI-AppleSilicon-FP8) plus **torch 2.11+**. See panel B for why.

nodes.title: Recipe & Mac gotchas
widgets_values:
## RECIPE & MAC GOTCHAS

**Official recipe:** euler · Ideogram4Scheduler · DualModelGuider cfg 7 · CFGOverride 3.0 @ 0.7 to 1.0

**Official presets:**
- V4_QUALITY_48: steps 48, mu 0.0, std 1.50
- V4_DEFAULT_20: steps 20, mu 0.0, std 1.75
- V4_TURBO_12: steps 12, mu 0.5, std 1.75

Ideogram states Quality 48 is its default. This workflow ships Default 20; the seedhunt workflow ships Turbo 12. Both at 1088x1920.

**Dimensions:** the prompt builder drives width and height for BOTH Ideogram4Scheduler and the latent, so they cannot drift apart. Set them on the builder. Keep them multiples of 16.

* 16, 256)`.

**Why fp8.** Comfy-Org ships Ideogram 4 only as fp8_scaled, int8_convrot and nvfp4, there is no dense bf16 build. Recent ComfyUI can dequantise-fallback for the other two, so they are not strictly impossible, but neither has an optimised quantised path on Metal. fp8_scaled + the AppleSilicon-FP8 node is the route worth using in ComfyUI. (Outside ComfyUI, MFLUX runs Ideogram 4 through MLX.)

**Measured memory:** on a 48 GB M-series with `--lowvram --disable-smart-memory`, peak across a 14-render batch at 1088x1920 ranged **36.8 to 44.4 GB of 48**, including a ~**14 GB** macOS/app baseline, under 4 GB free at the worst point. Treat ~2 MP as a ceiling. Do NOT raise the MPS watermark to dodge an OOM; lower the resolution instead.

**Measured speed** (sampler's own s/it): 720x1280 = 11.0, 896x1600 = 15.9, 1088x1920 = 23.3. Linear with pixels, ~11 to 12 s/it per megapixel. At the shipped 1088x1920: TURBO_12 ~5 min, DEFAULT_20 ~8 min, QUALITY_48 ~19 min, plus a one-time model load of 1 to 2 minutes. Drop to 1024x1024 for roughly half.

**MPS batch rule:** batch_size must stay **1**. Higher and only the first image denoises; the rest come out as static. Queue many separate jobs instead.

**LoRA rule:** never set a LoRA to strength 0.0 on MPS; it NaNs to a pure black image. Bypass the node with **Ctrl+B** instead.

**Prompt grammar:** the prompt must be a **JSON caption**, not prose. Ideogram 4 is out-of-distribution on plain text: worse output AND false-positive refusals (the model draws a flat gray blocked card). See **CAPTIONS.md** in the repo for the full grammar.

**Using the builder:** drag on its canvas to draw a region, click to select, and set each region to obj or text with its description. It writes the JSON caption for you, including the [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] 0-1000 bbox convention that is easy to get backwards by hand. Hit "Grab BG" to draw the next layout on top of your last render.
